dev.note: 10 hard items (dense recall 0) used to diagnose v1 and write prompt v2. ar-EG:r16 replaces an item of a former set (identical question text). On 2026-10-12 the Arabic items were moved to the Modern Standard Arabic set (ar), the text used in the earlier runs; ar-SY and ar-EG are now dialect sets. On 2026-10-12 the Turkish set was dropped (no reviewer available); its items here were replaced by the same question in en, or in ar for questions that name the asker's nationality. Runs before that date used the Turkish text.

validation.note: 20 random items, stratified by module and type, ids disjoint from dev in every language; seed 20261009. Use to compare prompt versions and models. On 2026-10-12 a former set was replaced by the Egyptian set (ar-EG): ar-EG:q01 names an Egyptian asker; the other replaced items have identical question text. On 2026-10-12 the Arabic items were moved to the Modern Standard Arabic set (ar), the text used in the earlier runs; ar-SY and ar-EG are now dialect sets. On 2026-10-12 the Turkish set was dropped (no reviewer available); its items here were replaced by the same question in en, or in ar for questions that name the asker's nationality. Runs before that date used the Turkish text.
